criteria.name: Accuracy of Information
criteria.feedback: All your statements about technology's impact are accurate, well-supported, and free from factual errors or misleading claims, fully satisfying the accuracy requirement for this assignment.

criteria.name: Adherence to Essay Conventions
criteria.feedback: Your essay is formatted appropriately and is free of distracting grammar, spelling, or punctuation errors, which makes it smooth and professional to read. Great work maintaining strong writing conventions throughout!

criteria.name: Organization and Coherence
criteria.feedback: Your essay lacks a clear introduction, body, and conclusion, making ideas feel disconnected and difficult to follow. For higher scores, organize your thoughts into structured paragraphs with a beginning, middle, and end.

criteria.name: Precision and Clarity of Language
criteria.feedback: Your writing is consistently clear, concise, and precise, expressing ideas unambiguously without any vague or awkward phrasing. Excellent job meeting the expectations for clarity and precision in your language.

criteria.name: Relevance to Prompt
criteria.feedback: Your essay stays directly focused on technology's impact throughout, discussing its role in daily life without digressions. Excellent job maintaining relevance to the prompt.
